stem: A biostimulant claims to improve nutrient uptake in every crop and medium. What is the strongest evaluation approach?
choices: Identify its composition and mechanism, review evidence in comparable systems, define a measurable outcome and compare against a baseline
Accept the claim because the product is natural
Apply several other new products at the same time
Judge only from the product name
rationale: Product claims should be evaluated from mechanism, evidence quality, context and measurable outcome rather than category or testimonial.
